attribute_definitions_value_range_check.name: attribute_definitions_value_range_check
attribute_definitions_value_range_check.value: "attribute_definitions"."min_value" IS NULL OR "attribute_definitions"."max_value" IS NULL OR "attribute_definitions"."min_value" <= "attribute_definitions"."max_value"

attribute_definitions_value_type_check.name: attribute_definitions_value_type_check
attribute_definitions_value_type_check.value: "attribute_definitions"."data_type" IN ('number', 'decimal') OR ("attribute_definitions"."min_value" IS NULL AND "attribute_definitions"."max_value" IS NULL)

orders_document_invoice_status_consisten.name: orders_document_invoice_status_consistency_check
orders_document_invoice_status_consisten.value: ("orders"."document_type" = 'invoice' AND "orders"."invoice_status" IS NOT NULL) OR ("orders"."document_type" = 'sales_note' AND "orders"."invoice_status" IS NULL)
